AdminUser.description: An account as an admin sees it. ``local`` marks the owner of songs from single-user mode.
AdminUser.title: AdminUser

ErrorDetail.description:
Translatable message. Shape: ``{key, message, params}``.

The UI looks ``key`` up under ``errors`` in its catalogs and falls back to
the English ``message``. ``params`` fills ``{name}`` placeholders.
ErrorDetail.title: ErrorDetail

ImportPreview.description: Fretted tracks on a Songsterr link, before the import is queued.
ImportPreview.title: ImportPreview

Job.description: Background import. ``error_key`` is an ``errors`` catalog key; ``progress_key`` is a catalog key.
Job.title: Job

Me.description:
The caller. In single-user mode this is the ``local`` user and ``authenticated`` is false.

``role`` comes from the provider's groups at sign-in; it is always ``user`` in single-user mode.
Me.title: Me

Meta.description:
Server identity. ``auth_mode`` is ``single`` or ``oidc``.

``commit`` is the git SHA of a non-release image build. It is ``null`` for a release (``v*`` tag) or a
source checkout.
Meta.title: Meta

Settings.description: Per-user preferences. ``default_instrument`` is a preset id from ``GET /api/meta``.
Settings.title: Settings

SongExport.description:
Attachment from ``GET /api/songs/{song_id}/export.json``.

A tab includes ``document`` and omits ``chordpro``. A chord sheet does the opposite.
SongExport.title: SongExport

SyncMap.description:
Backing-track alignment, keyed by song-level bar index.

``points`` are source timestamps in seconds (Songsterr video points), one
per bar; ``None`` means the source had none for that bar. ``anchors`` are
the user's taps, keyed by bar index. Playback uses anchors when present,
otherwise points. Repeats are not rendered yet, so the bar index is also
the playback index; once they are, anchors need a play-through occurrence.
SyncMap.title: SyncMap

TrackBar.description: One track's content for one song-level bar. No voices, or empty voices, is a full-bar rest.
TrackBar.title: TrackBar

ValidationBody.description: Request validation failed (HTTP 422). ``detail`` is a list of issues, not a keyed error.
ValidationBody.title: ValidationBody

ValidationIssue.description: One rejected field. The handler omits the submitted value.
ValidationIssue.title: ValidationIssue

YtDlpStatus.description: The yt-dlp that downloads audio. ``stale`` means its release is more than 30 days old.
YtDlpStatus.title: YtDlpStatus

info.description: JSON API for the web app. Every route is under /api. Errors use the shape {"detail": {"key", "message", "params"}}; the UI looks `key` up under `errors` and falls back to the English `message`. Single-user mode has no login: every request is the local user. With OIDC (FRETBOOK_OIDC_ISSUER set) a browser signs in through GET /auth/login, GET /auth/callback and POST /auth/logout, which are not JSON and not listed here; every route but /api/health then answers 401 auth.required without a session cookie.
info.title: Fretbook
